purpose: The one place the certified rewards-treasury binary is named. Sibling of launchpad-binary.certification.json. propose-squads-upgrade.mjs refuses a buffer whose bytes are not the binary certified for the program it is asked to upgrade: on 2026-09-24 a proposal put treasury bytes into the launchpad program, and no tool in the path knew that the two did not belong together.

certifiedBy.gate: scripts/solana/run-local-treasury-gate.sh (18 tests: reward poster airdrop + league, three separate league vaults, program-owned arena receivers, poker ranks up to 255) and cargo test -p mwz_rewards_treasury --lib (28)

deployed.mainnet: NOT upgraded to this candidate. Mainnet runs 1028f6f8a52037f1aea8ab2e6ae86f9e2c1224eed7e1e7b71675cdfca2508a95 (1306640 bytes, Squads #18). Candidate needs solana program extend +87400 bytes first.
